reviews.title: Cute but unusable for me
reviews.text: This is a really cute app that has some cool parts to it. Unfortunately it doesn’t have widgets and that’s a dealbreaker for me. Many people with ADHD deal with object permanence issues—meaning out-of-sight, out-of-mind. I have tried pretty much every ADHD app out there and I’m always disappointed when one doesn’t have widgets. It’s so important for so many of us ADHD-ers! I need to be able to see my to-dos and other info right on my Home Screen and I know I’m not alone in that. If this app had widgets, I would definitely give it a try!

reviews.title: The Best!
reviews.text:
I love how simple this is to use!  You can create as many presets as you want.  Like, one morning routine for workdays and one for non workdays.  

I have a preset for when company is coming because I always need to clean the bathroom, clean the kitchen, etc.  So I can quickly load the preset and then add anything I need, like if I'm making food ahead of time.  This app tells me how long it's going to take and shows me when I'll finish if I start now.

I love how it shows the overall time, but I don't feel forced into set time blocks and I can change the order of tasks with a quick drag.  So I can have some flexibility, but still get everything done in time.  Standard time blocking has been a nightmare for me.  What if I don't want to start vacuuming at 10:00?  Then I feel like a failure!  This is way better for my brain!

reviews.title: Been searching for this app my whole life
reviews.text: So thankful I found it. Everything I wanted in an app — start and end time, time remaining, exact end time, goblin tasks-style task breakdowns, cute UI, visual timer🤌🤌

reviews.title: Too expensive
reviews.text: It would be 5 stars except that the subscription is too expensive for what it is. It doesn’t even have a watch app. I’ve used better known apps with far more features that were less expensive than this. I really wish I could give it 5 stars and it would be my one main productivity app but I just can’t justify the cost.

reviews.title: Very helpful for fun productivity
reviews.text:
If you need an app to keep you on track and remind you what you are doing, this is it! Love this app and it just keeps getting better!  

Lately I’ve been using it every night when preparing for tomorrow. I get done so much faster with it. (At least 1/2 hour)

Presets (saved lists) are my favorite. I use it for my nightly routine above. As it evolves, I can update the preset to work with me. Already did this with my morning routine. 

Great out of the box, but also love the customizations that are available (colors, emojis, reminder sounds, confetti and more).

Give it a try!  It’s makes your possibilities list (aka to do list) much more fun and you more likely to finish a few more tasks.

reviews.title: Keeps me on track
reviews.text: This app has helped me immensely with planning my day. I’m much more realistic with how many tasks I schedule in a day because I can see what time my day will end! No more squeezing in 10+ hours into an 8 hour work day and feeling bad that I didn’t get everything done. As someone who skews toward the time blind, thank you for making this!

reviews.title: Nice app, even nicer free trial
reviews.text:
Anyone with adhd knows that free trials are a nightmare and trying to cancel them is a whole ordeal. So I really really really appreciate the fact that I am allowed to try this app out without having to sign up for anything or put my card in or sign up through the Apple Store for the trial. 

Anyways, I haven’t been using it for long (still in the trial lol) but I’m liking the app a lot! I like that it’s basic and there isn’t a ton of extra stuff you don’t need. If you don’t want to do a task now, just say not now. No scheduling or notifications needed. 

I haven’t made any preset lists yet, I’ll probably wait until I’m able to pay for a subscription and then try those out then. But, just kinda adding tasks throughout the day is working for me on its own. I don’t want to get too overwhelmed with the lists!

reviews.title: Time boxing that works
reviews.text:
Llama life has saved my mornings!  I have a list of tasks that need to be done every day, plus I write best before noon so I want to get some focused time in as well. Before Llama life I forgot steps or got distracted or spent longer than I meant to on various things.  Now I load my morning routine into Llama life when I wake up and get all my “must dos”’done by lunch time.  

Also it’s adorable and fun.

reviews.title: Cancel?
reviews.text: This app is not what I want and there is no clear way to cancel. Directions in the app tell you to go to the App Store to cancel but there is nothing here. And if I want to delete my account I can’t just click a button I have to email the developer.

reviews.title: It’s EXACTLY what I need… locked 100% behind a paywall
reviews.text: They let you click it away, but then anything you click pulls up the paywall again no matter what you tap. Meaning this app isn’t free in any way, shape, or form.

reviews.title: Want to love it, but bugs are bugging me
reviews.text:
Llama Life in early 2026 is a half-finished app with distracting quirks. And we all know how ADHDers love a distraction. <s> 
When I name a task, the name is not saved unless I tap “Done” on the keyboard. If I switch apps to, say, check a date or copy a note, the task name will be gone when I return to Llama Life.
Even staying within the app, if I choose an emoji before tapping “Done,” the task name is lost. This is one picky llama and you have to do things her way. 
Just now I had a task list with just one item. I returned to it to add another one, and the list now contained six or seven more tasks all called “Untitled task” and with (appropriately) a “?” emoji on each. I had to clear the whole list and create my task again from scratch. This is not helping! 
This llama also expects you to comply with her rules about moving tasks to the main list before completing them. If you happen to finish tasks without your phone in front of you, and with the task still in the “Later” list, she won’t let you clear it until you move it to the main list and tap “Complete.” 
I do appreciate the app and I want it to improve and succeed. But there are many steps between here and there. By 2027 I hope to update this review and give 5 stars to an indispensable app that I can’t live without and can recommend without hesitation.

reviews.title: Alarm doesn’t work:-(
reviews.text: Really wanted to love this app., as I’m the target audience. But it’s very “almost”. For example, it’s nice to assign colors to tasks,  but there’s no space to actually color code (work, school, chores etc.) or make notes. There’s other stuff but the biggest thing is that 3x now, the alarm didn’t sound when a task ended, which obviously screws up my schedule and is…the whole point of the app!! Yes I updated, settings adjusted, but no dice. Emailed twice and no answer. Literally no choice but to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Just another Subscription Scam
reviews.text: Says it’s free but once you get into it, it’s just another subscription that’ll suck on your wallet for the rest of your life. Shame. I was excited to use it. Then it says it’ll charge you in a week if you don’t cancel within a week. THEN THE ONLY OPTION TO DELETE AND CANCEL YOUR ACCOUNT IS A 30 DAY DELAYED DELETION. If you charge me, then I’m going to be livid. I did NOT agree to any purchases.

reviews.title: If you miss 30/30…
reviews.text: At last - here’s an app to replace 30/30.  I’ve been looking for this for years!

reviews.title: Crash 6 months after purchase
reviews.text: No response from llama life

reviews.title: Keeps undoing my changes.
reviews.text: It's been great until recently. However, now, every time I make changes (add items for the day, rearrange the list, etc.), once the app closes, it reverts to its previous state. Even if the timer is running on an item, it just switches to the item that was at the top of the list previously and runs the timer for that item. It's really frustrating! I have a screen recording I'd be happy to share with support if I could contact them somehow!

reviews.title: needs internet to work
reviews.text:
Its frustrating that you can't update anything with a lack of internet connection.  at least half of the time I wanted to use this, I don't have an internet connection and that won't be changing.  I have no intention of using this on any other device than my phone,
so I don't need any connection.  Also, the breakdown tasks can't be edited, so when it generates nonsense(most of the time) I can't change it to works for me. Makes the feature worthless.

reviews.title: Amazing app and customer service
reviews.text: I’ve used Llama Life for so long now, that I even had made a separate account for an old job I no longer work at, in addition to my personal account! I hadn’t realized I was still doubly subscribed with that old email until my card was charged, but as soon as I reached out to the Llama Life team about it, they located the old account, canceled the recurring renewal and refunded my money. I’m grateful that an app that has been working so well for me also comes with a caring and passionate developer!

reviews.title: I LLiterally LLove LLama LLife
reviews.text:
This app has literally changed my day for the better! It is so helpful has visual timers, and fun customizables it’s perfect for people who want a set routine. You can even make premade lists, which is perfect because now I don’t need the checklist that I use every morning. This is the best app I’ve ever got for lists. thank you so much.
P.S. I have ADHD and it’s perfect for it!

reviews.title: My Favorite App for Time Management
reviews.text: I LOVE Llama Life so much. It’s my favorite app - I wish the app version could handle bulk task importing but otherwise - everything else is perfect! This team is super passionate about what they do and it shows!

reviews.title: Almost there! Add some critical features please!
reviews.text: As a mid-life ADHD-er, this app has helped me better understand how time blindness shows up, and has helped me be more realistic in planning my days. Missing a critical time stamp feature!!!! To know what time tasks were started and competed!!! Please add simple time stamp and this app will be supremely useful!!!!

reviews.title: Best customer support
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for over a year and it’s the best! Helps me more than any other app or platform has with staying on task. On top of a great product, their team is always so helpful and friendly when you have questions. I bumped into an issue downloading the desktop app on a new work computer and Marie was with me every step of the way!!

reviews.title: Can't even create a new task unless you pay
reviews.text: Obviously I understand that apps usually need to at least have paid subscriptions as an option, or they may even decide to have no free version and only do subscriptions. But I've never had a task management app -- or any app -- let me create an account, take me through a tutorial, and then let me find out that I quite literally can't use it AT ALL without a paid subscription. Like, can't even create a new task, nothing. The app seems like it's probably quite useful, and I understand some companies don't do free versions of their app, but I shouldn't be able to sign up thinking there's going to be a free version because nothing obvious has told me otherwise. I hope the devs will redo things to make it much more clear that you have to buy a subscription to use this app at all, saves some confusion and frustration!

reviews.title: I never knew…!
reviews.text: I couldn’t believe how long the smallest of things that we all do in the mornings and evenings take.  Well add ADHD to that and you can see how quickly time gets away from you and you’re constantly late. This app gently helps you to correct that.  Morning changer for me!!

reviews.title: Apple Watch support and a way to organize your presets would make this perfect
reviews.text: Love this app. I think Apple Watch support would make this even better  . Also maybe a way to search your presets would me awesome

reviews.title: Easy to Use!
reviews.text: This app is very easy to use, like the 7 day trial period to see if it will really work!  The only app that I’ve been able to get to work for me!

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.text: Literally just downloaded it but I can already tell this is gonna make my life so much easier. Routines, timers, everything is just perfect. The only unfortunate thing is there’s no iPad app :/ But I can deal with

reviews.title: Charged me even though I sent email requested cancellation prior to renewal.
reviews.text: Cancelling this app has been impossible. No one replies to email. No way to cancel in app. I sent an email which is what they said to do; got no reply and charged my card anyway. I’d give zero stars if I could.

reviews.title: I’m hooked!
reviews.text:
This is time-boxing for time-boxing-challenged people!! I have tried for years to time box (after other productivity hacks also failed) only to get off track and wind up overwhelmed and discouraged. I actually quit even trying because I knew I would just waste time replanning and re-replanning if the time slipped. And here is the thing Llama Life taught me. Time sometimes does slip. And it’s not a reflection on me. Sometimes a task just takes longer or an interruption happens. And the day isn’t a failure. 

Llama Life has just enough flexibility to adapt to the day’s situation. But not so much that you could go down a rabbit hole playing around in the app instead of moving through the day’s to-do’s. 

I am a paper planner person and have been looking for which one to buy for the new year. I’m so glad I found LL before I purchased my annual planner because I won’t need a day planner at all, just a simple place for my goals and projects. I trust Llama Life to help me keep my days focused and productive. And even fun!!

I will be passing along this gift of joy to many loved ones.

reviews.title: Life Changing
reviews.text: I seriously don’t know how I ever managed to organize my workday or stay on task before Llama Life. It’s become one of the most important tools in my ADHD toolkit to help me pace and adjust my days without being too rigid or hard on myself. And their customer support is so helpful and genuine! They really are the best and I am loving all of the updates and improvements made since the beginning. 10/10 do recommend!

reviews.title: a different kind of task app, and so helpful
Sick of paywalls
reviews.text: Just be up front and honest with your pricing. I expect to pay for a good app but I immediately delete apps that give no expectation in the description of how the app charges and you don’t get that information until after you “sign up” and the company has your information.

reviews.title: Life Changing!
reviews.text: This app solves my time-blindness issues! Such a clever approach to time-boxing. I’ve tried MANY productivity apps over the years, and this one is my very favorite. (And it pairs well with the GTD method). This app halts my habitual tendency to overbook myself (always thinking I can squish more into a day than can be done. . . leading to overwhelm). Llama life helps me set guard rails and calms my projects—and my mind. Plus the UI is intuitive, pretty, well organized, and whimsical. What a delight. Thank you so much! 5 stars!! No, make that 6. :-)

reviews.title: Best productivity app!!
reviews.text: I’ve been using Llama Life for several years now and it’s helped tremendously. I was super happy when the iOS app launched and I use it regularly to help organize my tasks. I love being able to see how long a task list will take (helps with time blindness) and all the fun visual perks help keep it exciting and fun to complete tasks. Devs are very hands-on, responsive, and listen to users when adding and updating features. Cannot recommend this enough!!

reviews.title: Such a fun and VERY helpful app
reviews.text: I absolutely love Llama Life! It makes getting through the workday a joy :)

reviews.title: Love this app
reviews.text:
I love this. I can set up a morning routine and then it counts down each step of events and how long I expect it to take. Seeing a list with an active count down timer really helps me visualize what I need to do and how much time I have to do it, rather than getting sidetracked.

That said, I really wish this app had some other features (because now I have to use other apps in supplement to this one, which sometimes makes it a bit inconvenient). 
— I wish the in app sound would offer more than just relaxing nature noises but rather a clock/timer tick sound or a water droplet sound that CONTINUES to play even if you exit the app/start playing music. 
— This is one of the biggest things- the timer should be able to show and continue running in the Lock Screen or at least create an interactive widget feature. If I close out of the app and I play music or something, the notification simply says “timer will keep running” rather than a current count down of your task / and the ability to mark as complete/etc. This is the biggest inconvenience of the app compared to other promodoro or task management apps. 
IF the second feature was available, this would genuinely be an app I could not live without and would be such an immense game changer.

reviews.title: Simply the best tool for ADHDers
reviews.text: This app has done more for my ADHD than anything outside of counseling and medication. It’s the only tool that has stuck and it really helps me move through my day productively. So grateful for this app!

reviews.title: The best time boxing app
reviews.text: Tried hundreds of apps and llama is exactly what I wanted all this time. Simple yet flexible.

reviews.title: Llama life saves my day, again and again
reviews.text: I’ve been using llama life for a year and I absolutely love it. I don’t use it every day but when my ADHD throws me for a loop the llama is there for the rescue this way doesn’t turn into a bad week because by day two the llama gets me back on track. Thank you to the team for the todoist implementation - super convenient . The best part, however, is the “surprise me” color button. 🌈 It’s such a silly thing but I just push that button and I smile! Thank you, Llama team, you are awesome!!!!!

reviews.title: So much potential, yet falls short.
reviews.text:
Ever since the 30/30 timer disappeared, I’ve been looking for a replacement.  Llama life looks similar but I can’t figure out how to creat multiple routines that just stay as complete routines to chose from.

If I have to recreate routines each time and then they contribute to AN ENTIRE day as a whole (without the ability to easily mix and match pre-made routines), this is a huge barrier to use.

For instance, I want to be able to create different morning routines (that just live within the app so I can select them), multiple work routines, multiple evening routines, etc.

reviews.title: seems awesome!
reviews.text: Just started the free trial but I really love this so far! a good friend recommended it and got it set up for me. It reminds me a lot of the function of Routinery which I use for my repeated everyday tasks, and i think the similarity will make this app even more useable for me. Very excited to keep using it!

reviews.title: Confetti makes life better
reviews.text:
I had been using the web version of this app for a while. It is fun which makes me want to use it. Different colors, emojis and confetti when you complete a task. But don’t let the fun interface fool you. This app has a ton of useful features such as chimes to remind you you were working, automatic breaking down of tasks, integration with notion or todoist (which integrates with Evernote), and loads of other things. The team is super responsive to help you if you run into a snag. 
And did o mention the mini celebration when you complete something? Oh, well, it makes using the app fun enough that I actually do it and my productivity is way higher when I am using llama life!!

reviews.title: live love llama!
reviews.text: Llama life is the best app for task organization, timekeeping, motivation, and focus I have found—and believe me, I have tried them all! I had been looking forever for something that could approximate 30/30 (long discontinued, but it was so helpful for me with timeboxing and task completion), and Llama life is it! Especially now that Llama Life is also an app (used to only be on my desktop/laptop) it is even better! Llama life (and the presets, colors, emoji integration, throwing of confetti when you complete tasks) is the best ever. I’d buy stock if I could! They are also super receptive to feedback. All around winning app. Thanks Llama Life!

reviews.title: Love Llama Life
reviews.text: I love this app! I have tried so many productivity apps, but this is the one for me.

reviews.title: Just get this app already
reviews.text:
I am lucky enough to be part of the development. This team is dedicated to the community, the development of the app and always a pleasure to communicate with. 

As far as the app- I use it daily. What makes it different is the time shown for each task and the total time for a group of tasks. For example, if I need to do my morning tasks I know it’s a total of 1.5hrs, but I know I have to leave the house in 1hr- then I can adjust the list of tasks and move the tool to show the exact time ie. 8:43AM that it would take to complete all the morning tasks.

I love knowing how long it will take to complete a group of tasks and when that group would be complete. I have over 20+ tasks in a given day. Llama Life is the only way I get these things done!

Pro tip: add a prelist of breaks to add into your task list if you have a hard time taking breaks

reviews.title: Order out of Chaos
reviews.text: We started using the web version in August as a caregiving/med/hydration schedule keeper. The first week I used LlamaLife I got 15+ more hours of sleep from staying right on schedule. We were 30/30 people so we’ve been adrift after accidentally updating the ancient iPad we used that with. But this app was the even-better revelation we needed to help us get and keep on schedule.

reviews.title: Fantastic for ADHD Productivity!
reviews.text:
I love Llama Life! I have been using it for over a year, and I'm super excited that it's on iPS now! 

Still missing a couple useful features from the web app like Todoist sync, but the devs are working on it. And you can still set things up on the web, let it sync to mobile, and then go from there.

If you have ADHD, like the idea of pomodoro, but struggle with the other apps out there, this app is the miracle you have been looking for!

reviews.title: Excellent app
reviews.text: I find Llama life to be so useful and helpful with my day to day productivity. And it’s so fun! I couldn’t live without it.

reviews.title: Live. Laugh. Llama. 💕
reviews.text:
For years, there has been a 30/30-shaped hole in my heart, and I have bounced from app to app searching for a worthy replacement. I found the Llama Life website a few weeks ago and was disappointed to see that it was via Internet only, but then I was almost immediately thrilled to read that an iOS app was to release within the month. Talk about perfect timing! 

Words cannot convey how much this app means to me. As an ADHD woman whose sense of time is vestigial at best, finding a app that works with my brain is like birthday and Christmas rolled into one. 30/30 worked for me, and then it just… went away. 😭 I mourned that app the way other people might mourn lost family members. There is no telling how much time and money I’ve wasted searching for a replacement, but the search is finally over! HUZZAH. (That’s what the kids say nowadays, right??)

To the developers of Llama Life, thank you thank you THANK YOU for all of your hard work. All of the features, the colors, emoji, the ability to break tasks down, to save routines, to easily enter times, the end time estimate, the planned vs. actual time, the divider bar… This app feels like it was designed especially for me. I cannot wait to see where you take it, and I’ll be a subscriber all the way!

reviews.title: The only app I use for managing my day!
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Llama Life on desktop for about ten months, and it simplifies and gameifies the dreaded daily to-do list. So to now have this handy system on my phone really transforms the entire day for me! I’m able to manage my tasks as I’m doing them in different rooms of the house, or even out and about running errands! As an ADHDer, this is especially helpful as I can get detailed so easily and succumb to distractions and side quests!

My favorite part of Llama Life is how they’ve managed to make something like a boring to-do list into something fun! Confetti, chimes, and the colors and themes just make it more appealing. I save my preset lists for routine-setting, check over my reports to see if I stuck to my time estimation, and even use their AI-assisted emoji matching to make those tasks even more fun. 

Can’t wait to see what’s next for Llama Life!

reviews.title: My favorite productivity app
reviews.text: Using it is such a pleasant experience. The app is simple and very fun to use. Recommend to anyone 🦙🦙🦙🦙🦙

reviews.title: Great daily productivity tool!
reviews.text: I’ve been using Llama Life desktop for a year. I link it to Todoist. Every morning it brings up the things to spend time on for that day. I use it for both the everyday (workout, reach out reminders) to specific tasks (write memo etc). It fundamentally changes your understanding of where you spend your time so that you can set right expectations and prioritize the most important things to you. I love it and highly recommend.

reviews.title: I love Llama Life and I use it everyday
reviews.text: The iOS app is a great addition to the web app and has a great look and feel. So cool to finally a native version of this app!

reviews.title: A unique and interesting way to motivate people
reviews.text: This app approached motivation differently than most other apps out there and it works! I love all the small carefully crafted details to keep me motivated and long the right path, and would highly recommend everyone check it out!

reviews.title: The best app for getting things done!
reviews.text:
Huge fan of this company, what they offer, how helpful they are, and the look of the app.

There is not a single app out there on the market like Llama Life! You can fully customize your task lists, create built-in templates, break tasks down when your list overwhelms you, let you start with a random task, and so so much more.

reviews.title: Game changer!
reviews.text: Llama life has changed my life! It helps me focus and be realistic about what can and cannot be done in a day. The audio cues are so helpful in maintaining focus. Their support team has been amazing with questions. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: Love This App
reviews.text: Love this app since it’s web-only days! Great to have it on the iPhone.

reviews.title: Personal Game Changer
reviews.text: I have been using the web app for some time now with tremendous results to my personal journey with ADD and time blindness. Now with the IOS app I can be more productive away from my desk. Super stoked. Thanks to the developers for bringing this to market.

reviews.title: Fun Way to Stay Intentional
reviews.text: So glad the mobile app is here. This app that wants to protect your time, attention and focus for what you want to do when so many other apps want to consume your attention.

reviews.title: I’m a Llama for Life!
reviews.text:
I have ADHD and, as an entrepreneur who must focus on tasks to get them DONE (as opposed to partially done in a thousand open tabs), Llama Life has been a lifesaver. Every aspect of the app (which I’ve been using on desktop for years) is a delight, from the colors to the icons to the branding… it even helps me break down my tasks into steps if I get stuck. Something about knowing I only have to do an unpleasant task for 20 minutes and then I can do something else… while listening to a focus-inducing soundscape… it makes the impossible possible.

This is SUCH a worthwhile app. There is none other like it… and believe me, I have tried DOZENS of apps. This one is both practical and delightful. It’s beautifully executed. I’m so glad I found it!

Also, who doesn’t llove llamas?🦙

reviews.title: Excited for the iOS app version!
reviews.text:
I started using Llama Life on the web awhile back, along with a lot of my coworkers. It’s a huge help with work tasks, and I’ve been really excited for the iOS app to make it easier to use for personal tasks. It really does help my brain stay on track, and it’s fun to use.

Congrats on launching the app, Llama Life team!
